mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right AI SEO provider for my CPA firm in New York City?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AI SEO provider for your CPA firm in New York City, look for one with demonstrated experience in both SEO and the financial/accounting sector. They should understand the specific compliance requirements and client acquisition challenges unique to CPAs. Evaluate their proficiency with AI tools and their ability to integrate them into a comprehensive strategy. Request case studies or client testimonials, particularly from local businesses if possible. Ensure they offer transparent reporting, clear communication, and a customized approach rather than a one-size-fits-all solution, focusing on your specific NYC market goals and client base.
